embedded.label: Engagement model #1
embedded.unavailableNote: Full-time commitment to an existing client. Project-based engagements remain open.
embedded.title: Consultancy mission
embedded.description: Full-time integration within your team. On-site or remote, exclusive, long-term. All the benefits of a senior in-house designer, without the overhead.
embedded.item1: UX/UI leadership across your digital products and features
embedded.item2: Design system creation, ownership and maintenance
embedded.item3: Frontend integration alongside your development team
embedded.item4: Brand consistency across all internal and external touchpoints
embedded.item5: Operational support, team alignment and design process coaching

project.label: Engagement model #2
project.title: Project-based
project.description: A defined scope, a clear outcome. Focused engagement that fits around your roadmap, flexible hours and and can run alongside other client projects.
project.item1: UX audit, redesign or product design from scratch
project.item2: Brand identity, logo and visual system
project.item3: Website or web application design and development
project.item4: Design system creation for a specific product or platform
project.item5: Frontend sprint, integration or technical handoff

cta.title: Starting with a conversation costs nothing.
cta.subtitle: Let's explore what we could build together.

step1.title: Discovery
step1.description: We discuss your needs, constraints and goals to clearly scope the project.

step2.title: Design
step2.description: Mockups, brand identity or design system: I craft whatever turns your needs into a clear, consistent, engaging result.

step3.title: Development
step3.description: If your project includes a website or app, I build it with clean, rigorous code, faithful to the validated design.

step4.title: Delivery
step4.description: Launch, testing and hands-on training to get you comfortable with your new tool.

step5.title: Follow-up
step5.description: Adjustments, improvements and support after delivery, for a tool that evolves with you.

experience.title: Experiences.
experience.description: Over 10 years across radically different environments, biotech startups, media groups, local SMEs, SaaS scale-ups, have taught me to adapt fast, understand each sector's business challenges, and deliver consistent results regardless of the structure.

portfolio.title: Selected works.
portfolio.description: A collection of digital products and brand identities crafted with care, at the intersection of human behavior and technological capability.
